ios.desc:
Obeo connects everything to your health. We take your data and overlay it with environmental and social context. Think your sleep, HRV, temperature, environment/weather, symptoms, calendar, and wearable data all into one health engine to tell you what's coming - before you feel it.

Most health apps track. Obeo forecasts. 

Why? Because health is complex. It's not just "one" thing.

By combining signals from Apple Watch, Oura Ring, your symptom logs, your calendar, and more, Obeo spots the patterns that lead to illness and warns you days in advance.

HOW IT WORKS
- Connect Apple Health, Oura Ring, WHOOP, all, or none (wearable NOT required)
- Log symptoms and how you feel in seconds
- Obeo reads across every data source simultaneously and our algorithms ingest your nuanced inputs
- Get a daily health briefing with clear, actionable insights
- Receive predictive alerts when your risk is rising

DAILY HEALTH BRIEFING
One screen daily. Know how your environment is correlated to your health. Your sleep quality, heart rate variability, recovery status, and symptom trends distilled into a briefing you can read in 30 seconds.

ILLNESS PREDICTION
Obeo detects when your body is heading toward illness before you feel sick. Poor sleep + elevated resting heart rate + a packed schedule? Obeo sees the pattern and alerts you in time to act.

SMART CORRELATIONS
Why do you always get sick after travel? Why does poor sleep hit you harder on busy weeks? Obeo finds correlations across your data that you'd never spot on your own.

TRAVEL INTELLIGENCE 
Flying somewhere? Obeo monitors your destination for health risks, builds a jet lag recovery plan, and tracks how travel stress affects your immunity. All automatically. 

CALENDAR INTELLIGENCE
Obeo reads your schedule alongside your health data and helps you plan your week around your body, not against it.

WORKS WITH WHAT YOU WEAR (OR DON'T WEAR)
Apple Watch, Oura Ring, WHOOP, all, or none. More data sources mean smarter predictions. No extra hardware required - Apple Health and manual logging itself get you started.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
All health data is processed on-device and never sold. Period.

--

SUBSCRIPTION
Obeo operates on a freemium basis. Obeo Pro unlocks travel intelligence, deep personalized correlations, calendar health insights, and advanced briefing intel.

--

Disclaimer: Obeo by SoinsAI Inc. provides wellness insights for educational purposes only. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease. Alw

Predict your next sick day. We combine your personal information (wearables/manual/voice input) with environmental data and regional social media data (what are people saying around you online that can be of concern/signal outbreak)

If you've heard of Death Clock, think of this as it's sick counterpart.

Trained on 66+ biomarker studies and backed by a physician advisory board. We are supported by people who come from Oxford, Northwestern, 1517 Fund, Thiel Fellowship/Foundation, Vanderbilt, Michigan, and more.

Check when you'll be sick next + prevention plan, now!
